nodes.label: ADR-006 Audited staff edit exception
nodes.summary: Accepted revision-workflow decision dated 2026-08-24, with permission alignment dated 2026-10-04: exceptional staff revision editing needs another actor approval and append-only before/after audit.
nodes.rationale: Emergency help must remain attributable and scoped without mutating the submitted original.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Append-only staff edit provenance
nodes.summary: Audit records actor, time, request ID, before/after and reason; approval and edits are separate events; UI says Diubah Petugas.
nodes.rationale: Identify emergency changes and their authors without overwriting history.

nodes.label: Shield workflow permission separation
nodes.summary: Request, approval and edit-session permissions are separate; role names are not hardcoded; self-approval prohibited even for super-admin.
nodes.rationale: Permission bypass must not erase separation of duties.

nodes.label: KKPRL workflow policies excluded from Shield CRUD generation
nodes.summary: Review policy maps viewAny/view to Review:KkprlProposal; approval lists allow review or approval permission; two resources excluded from generated generic policy overrides.
nodes.rationale: List visibility must not grant approval/edit/download actions or overwrite domain policies.

edges.evidence: Audited emergency editing aligns with two-person approval lifecycle
